Style check: this example has no custom CSS, so its appearance still uses browser defaults.
Behavior at the start: the score is zero and the controls are ready.
A Power Hit at score zero is refused because five points are required.
After five monster clicks, the score reaches five and the level message changes.
A Power Hit now succeeds and spends the five points.
After building the score to ten, the game displays its master-level message.

Structure: HTML only, before CSS or JavaScript.
Style: the same HTML with CSS applied; JavaScript is still off.
Behavior: three balls begin the drop at the same height.
After the same elapsed simulation time, the balls reach different heights because their restitution values differ.
Show colliders overlays the physics shapes on the visible balls and floor.
Drop again resets all three balls to their common starting height.
Structure: HTML only, before CSS or JavaScript.
Style: the same HTML with CSS applied; JavaScript is still off.
Behavior: the marble, crates, gems, and gate are loaded on the ready screen.
Start creates a playing world with five gems and three lives.
Show colliders reveals the marble, solid obstacles, and collectible sensor shapes.
Holding Left and Up rolls the marble into a gem sensor. The gem disappears and the counter becomes Gems: 1/5.
Pause suspends the physics game and shows the paused status.
